text: キャハハ　かるく　ひとひねり　してやるわ！

structure.jp: ひとひねり　してやるわ！

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.span: ひとひねり　してやる
patterns.explanation: てやる after a verb says you will do it to someone, in a rough and threatening way. ひとひねり　してやる = 'I'll crush you'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end softens a statement and sounds womanly. してやるわ = 'I'll do it to you!'.
